summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str(obj) with sep, delegates once to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow="ignore", crop off, highlight defaulting to True). Added the CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under Unreleased/Added, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after logging, and tests in tests/test_console.py (RenderHook imported at top; test_out plus markup, emoji, container, no-crop, style, highlight, and render-hook tests). Tests were not run, per instructions, so they are unverified. Highlight tests assert presence or absence of "\x1b[" rather than exact bytes. Nothing was committed.
